risk_note: RV2 ledger (D10-220 ①; BR-WDR-05 (a), BR-FUND-10). The posting step shared by post and reverse() compares each user account's available balance before and after in the same transaction and calls an injected BalanceRecoveredHook only when it goes from < 0 to >= 0 (zero counts as non-negative; accounts judged separately; a replayed uniq_key returns duplicate and does not call again). The hook is declared by ledger, has an empty default, and is implemented and injected by payout (dependency payout -> ledger); ledger never writes withdrawals and uses no async event for this. It coexists with account.went_negative from B2-04k: EVENT_BUS and the hook are both optional injections active on the same instance, and a hook error rolls the whole voucher back together with the event. Only apps/api/src/modules/ledger/** changed.
